input: Exact D1 Raw-derived DELTA14 BEFORE PR, not ABS14, engineered ABS18, latent96 or 28D concatenation
pr: Call original pinned uas_core.patient_z: float64 per-patient canonical-channel population mean/std; SD<=1e-8 => denominator1. This is M8's physiological D1-input PR, not its separate latent96 PR.
version_B: Same DELTA14 with original patient_z, still14D
preprocessing: FIT-only mean imputer all classifiers; FIT-only StandardScaler LR/SVM/MLP; native unscaled RF/XGBoost. SVM calibration subfold preprocessors refitted on their own sub-FIT only.
weighting: Every FIT patient has equal pre-class-weight sum; then inverse pooled FIT class-frequency weights; normalized patient weights mean1. Same policy A/B and all five classifiers. Platt uses patient-only weights, no class balancing.
inner_split: Exact original M8 FIT/validation patients within each outer fold. Same split across all10 groups. No FIT+VAL refit.
hyperparameter_selection: At each classifier/fold, choose ONE common configuration for A/B using equal mean validation patient MacroF1 across A/B, then mean patient AP, then mean patient AUROC, then earlier grid index. Versions share grid, selected topology/parameters and seed.
threshold_selection: Each version uses own validation EZ-probability grid0..1 step.005. Max patient-mean classMacroF1, then positiveEZF1, nearest.5, lower threshold. No auxiliary metric in ties. EZ iff calibrated/native pEZ >= threshold.
svm_calibration: RBF SVC;3 patient-held-out GroupKFold subfolds inside FIT only, shuffle seed42+1009*fold; refit scaler/imputer within sub-FIT; OOF margins -> patient-weighted Platt LogisticRegression(C1e6); finalSVC fits all legalFIT, calibration and numeric threshold frozen beforeTEST.
MLP: sklearn MLPClassifier ReLU/Adam .001; max400; no row-wise validation early stopping; n_iter_no_change20, tol1e-5; candidate grid is only architecture variation; matched A/B selection.
RF: 300 trees, sqrt max_features, bootstrap; n_jobs2. No global scaling.
XGBoost: 3.0.5 isolated venv; CPU hist; eta.05, min_child_weight5, subsample/colsample1, reglambda1, n_jobs2; no GPU change.
positive_class: EZ=1 derived from original yNEZ=0; continuous pEZ, not class predictions for AUROC/AP. Frozen references keep original decisions/NEZ thresholds.
primary_unit: 80 unique TEST patients equal weight; no fold-equal or pooled substitution
undefined_metrics: AUROC NaN if single truth class; AP/F1/ranking NaN if no true positives; precision/NPV NaN if prediction denominator0; MCC NaN if any factor of denominator0; finite means and effective counts reported. No silent exclusions.
calibration_metrics: Brier; LogLoss p clipped1e-15..1-1e-15; positive-class reliability ECE10 fixed uniform bins [0,.1),...,[.9,1]. Lower is better.
ranking: Within patient only; descending continuous pEZ, canonical-channel name breaks ties; precision@3 denominator min(3,n); NDCG@5 binary relevance/log2 discount/ideal top positives; no positive =>NaN+coverage.
paired_deltas: Metric B minus A; main-table mean differences and paired-common-finite patient differences both reported where coverage differs. Optional descriptive paired10000seed42patient bootstrap, fixed selections/thresholds.
outer: Freeze all50 model/preprocessor/calibration/threshold selections before one new frozen inference, seal50 prediction ledgers before full new TEST label read; no test-driven changes
privacy: Publish source, hashes and anonymous aggregates only; per_patient_metrics.csv and predictions.csv, models/preprocessors and all IDs/clinical labels remain trusted-server-private.
